summary: Well-architected workflow and scripts with strong PowerShell idioms (Set-StrictMode, proper error handling, comment-based help, Export-ModuleMember). Excellent glob pattern matching logic and priority resolution. GitHub Actions integration is correct (pinned actions@v4, least-privilege permissions, shell: pwsh). Minor: Pester installation step assumes PSGallery availability (acceptable for act/GitHub); 'Ensure PowerShell' check is nearly a no-op (line 43-49); module functions lack [ValidateNotNullOrEmpty()] decorators though they validate internally. No dead code or duplication. Modular design with clear separation (module, CLI wrappers, batch runner) supports testing and maintenance.
